hero.title: File:1958-02-04 - Form AL-569 - Tybee Accident Temporary Custodian Receipt.jpg
hero.artist: US Atomic Energy Commission / US Department of Defense
hero.credit: Screenshot from The Nuclear Information Project Archived November 3, 2005, at the Wayback Machine, Form AL-569, "Temporary Custodian Receipt (for maneuvers)," to U.S. Atomic Energy Commission, Albuquerque Operations, from James W. Twitty, Col., U.S. Air Force, February 4, 1958. Released under FOIA.
hero.source: 1958-02-04 - Form AL-569 - Tybee Accident Temporary Custodian Receipt
hero.description: "Temporary Custodian Receipt" for what would be the nuclear weapon lost in the 1958 Tybee Island mid-air collision. It indicates that the core (part "C") was "simulated," and not an actual fissile core of nuclear material.
